claims.claim: Added pinned ARCHITECTURE-only AOA-1 with two focused passes, finite registry membership and one CANDIDATE/NO_DECISION closure.
AOA subjects bind packet, work context, return reference, Human objective, constraints and bounded sources; mismatched snapshots reject and unavailable decisive sources require UNKNOWN/BLOCKER.

Both passes compare explicit A/B/C alternatives with necessity, feasibility, externalities, risks, reversibility, discriminating information and attributed episode costs; numeric costs require matching supplied evidence.

Architecture-specific adversarial challenges cover no-build, minimal delta, omitted consumers, hidden costs and irreversible risks; first-pass blockers require explicit grounded reconciliation and otherwise force NO_DECISION.
Explicit AOA transport modes reconstruct content and stage lineage, enforce privacy and size bounds, and require freshness before the second provider call and final return.

Extended the existing externally supplied Human V1-only selection boundary to isolated ARCHITECTURE attempts without invoking AOA semantics; TASK_AUTHORING interoperability and production V1 selection remain compatible.

All six prior profile contents remain unchanged, and focused regression cases were added for alternatives, UNKNOWN, blocker retention, Human selection, transport substitutions, privacy and scope breaches.
The committed changes are confined to the eight permitted files and document isolated R4 semantics while preserving canonical lifecycle authorities and production policy.
